meta.title: Girdling The Heavens, Joining The Stars
meta.description: Though we might be on different orbits, our hearts have the same goal.

units.rawText: In the Jiutian sector, near Saturn, aboard the Millennium Pegasus.
units.displayText: In the Jiutian sector, near Saturn, aboard the Millennium Pegasus.

spans.text: In the Jiutian sector, near Saturn, aboard the Millennium Pegasus.

units.rawText: Yup, data recovery for the Saturnian system is going well. We've finished recovering data from the safer areas.
units.displayText: Yup, data recovery for the Saturnian system is going well. We've finished recovering data from the safer areas.

spans.text: Yup, data recovery for the Saturnian system is going well. We've finished recovering data from the safer areas.

units.rawText: As for Titan, the most dangerous of the Saturnian satellites... Well, there's no need to worry. There won't be any problems as long as she's handling it.
units.displayText: As for Titan, the most dangerous of the Saturnian satellites... Well, there's no need to worry. There won't be any problems as long as she's handling it.

spans.text: As for Titan, the most dangerous of the Saturnian satellites... Well, there's no need to worry. There won't be any problems as long as she's handling it.

units.rawText: Her status? Same as always. You can probably guess where she is now, right? There are times when I find myself hoping that she'll start worrying about her own safety...
units.displayText: Her status? Same as always. You can probably guess where she is now, right? There are times when I find myself hoping that she'll start worrying about her own safety...

spans.text: Her status? Same as always. You can probably guess where she is now, right? There are times when I find myself hoping that she'll start worrying about her own safety...

units.rawText: The door to the garage opens, and the air immediately fills with loud jazz music, occasionally interspersed with the sound of metal striking metal.
units.displayText: The door to the garage opens, and the air immediately fills with loud jazz music, occasionally interspersed with the sound of metal striking metal.

spans.text: The door to the garage opens, and the air immediately fills with loud jazz music, occasionally interspersed with the sound of metal striking metal.

units.rawText: The green-haired Doll follows the music to its source and the person he's looking for.
units.displayText: The green-haired Doll follows the music to its source and the person he's looking for.

spans.text: The green-haired Doll follows the music to its source and the person he's looking for.

units.rawText: Arc reactor output is stable and there's 95% power left. That's sufficient charge for combat operations.
units.displayText: Arc reactor output is stable and there's 95% power left. That's sufficient charge for combat operations.

spans.text: Arc reactor output is stable and there's 95% power left. That's sufficient charge for combat operations.

units.rawText: Oxygen levels check, propellant check, thermal insulation suits check...
units.displayText: Oxygen levels check, propellant check, thermal insulation suits check...

spans.text: Oxygen levels check, propellant check, thermal insulation suits check...

units.rawText: Beepbeep—
units.displayText: Beepbeep—

spans.text: Beepbeep—

units.rawText: Hah, well yeah, Dolls don't really need to check O2 levels, but it just feels more proper this way, right?
units.displayText: Hah, well yeah, Dolls don't really need to check O2 levels, but it just feels more proper this way, right?

spans.text: Hah, well yeah, Dolls don't really need to check O2 levels, but it just feels more proper this way, right?

units.rawText: The short-haired Doll pounds on a red-hot piece of metal while adjusting data on various terminals.
units.displayText: The short-haired Doll pounds on a red-hot piece of metal while adjusting data on various terminals.

spans.text: The short-haired Doll pounds on a red-hot piece of metal while adjusting data on various terminals.

units.rawText: (Sigh)
units.displayText: Sigh

spans.text: Sigh

units.rawText: As the lively song is mercilessly interrupted, the short-haired Doll doesn't bother looking back—she already knows who the culprit is.
units.displayText: As the lively song is mercilessly interrupted, the short-haired Doll doesn't bother looking back—she already knows who the culprit is.

spans.text: As the lively song is mercilessly interrupted, the short-haired Doll doesn't bother looking back—she already knows who the culprit is.

units.rawText: Yuwang! They were just getting to the good part! Couldn't you have at least waited for the song to finish?
units.displayText: Yuwang! They were just getting to the good part! Couldn't you have at least waited for the song to finish?

spans.text: Yuwang! They were just getting to the good part! Couldn't you have at least waited for the song to finish?

units.rawText: Xinghuan, the Administrator's looking for you.
units.displayText: Xinghuan, the Administrator's looking for you.

spans.text: Xinghuan, the Administrator's looking for you.

units.rawText: Oh hi, good morning, Xuannu!
units.displayText: Oh hi, good morning, Xuannu!

spans.text: Oh hi, good morning, Xuannu!

units.rawText: Xinghuan turns to the communicator and forces a smile onto her face while surreptitiously shifting her body to conceal the object she was working on.
units.displayText: Xinghuan turns to the communicator and forces a smile onto her face while surreptitiously shifting her body to conceal the object she was working on.

spans.text: Xinghuan turns to the communicator and forces a smile onto her face while surreptitiously shifting her body to conceal the object she was working on.

units.rawText: I was just borrowing the workshop for a bit. You don't mind, right? Oh yeah, you're just in time! You seem a little down right now, and as it happens, I've got something to show you that should perk you right up!
units.displayText: I was just borrowing the workshop for a bit. You don't mind, right? Oh yeah, you're just in time! You seem a little down right now, and as it happens, I've got something to show you that should perk you right up!

spans.text: I was just borrowing the workshop for a bit. You don't mind, right? Oh yeah, you're just in time! You seem a little down right now, and as it happens, I've got something to show you that should perk you right up!

units.rawText: Tadaahhhh! It's the monomolecular vibroblade I just made! It's not too stable right now, but once it's perfected, we can mass produce it and even stick it on my exo-armor. What do you think?
units.displayText: Tadaahhhh! It's the monomolecular vibroblade I just made! It's not too stable right now, but once it's perfected, we can mass produce it and even stick it on my exo-armor. What do you think?

spans.text: Tadaahhhh! It's the monomolecular vibroblade I just made! It's not too stable right now, but once it's perfected, we can mass produce it and even stick it on my exo-armor. What do you think?

units.rawText: Xinghuan, you'll be heading down to Titan in 15 minutes to perform a data recovery. The data there...
units.displayText: Xinghuan, you'll be heading down to Titan in 15 minutes to perform a data recovery. The data there...

spans.text: Xinghuan, you'll be heading down to Titan in 15 minutes to perform a data recovery. The data there...

units.rawText: "The data there is extremely important; not only does it cover planetary biogenesis experimental data, but information regarding various technologies linked to interstellar exploration. Therefore you must make sure you recover all of it."
units.displayText: "The data there is extremely important; not only does it cover planetary biogenesis experimental data, but information regarding various technologies linked to interstellar exploration. Therefore you must make sure you recover all of it."

spans.text: "The data there is extremely important; not only does it cover planetary biogenesis experimental data, but information regarding various technologies linked to interstellar exploration. Therefore you must make sure you recover all of it."

units.rawText: This is what, the twentieth time you've said all that? Don't you get tired of it?
units.displayText: This is what, the twentieth time you've said all that? Don't you get tired of it?

spans.text: This is what, the twentieth time you've said all that? Don't you get tired of it?

units.rawText: This is only the seventh time. Also, you missed a point.
units.displayText: This is only the seventh time. Also, you missed a point.

spans.text: This is only the seventh time. Also, you missed a point.

units.rawText: There is entropic encroachment on the outskirts of Titan, and most of the agents in the base have already evacuated, which means there won't be anyone to meet you down there. You'll be alone during the mission, which is why you need to be more careful.
units.displayText: There is entropic encroachment on the outskirts of Titan, and most of the agents in the base have already evacuated, which means there won't be anyone to meet you down there. You'll be alone during the mission, which is why you need to be more careful.

spans.text: There is entropic encroachment on the outskirts of Titan, and most of the agents in the base have already evacuated, which means there won't be anyone to meet you down there. You'll be alone during the mission, which is why you need to be more careful.

units.rawText: Relax, I finished checking my exo. And besides, how many times have I gone on solo missions, anyway? Do you not trust me or something?
units.displayText: Relax, I finished checking my exo. And besides, how many times have I gone on solo missions, anyway? Do you not trust me or something?

spans.text: Relax, I finished checking my exo. And besides, how many times have I gone on solo missions, anyway? Do you not trust me or something?

units.rawText: That much is true, but the situation now is more dangerous than ever before. One mistake, and you won't even have the chance to be reset. Remember what happened on Haumea...
units.displayText: That much is true, but the situation now is more dangerous than ever before. One mistake, and you won't even have the chance to be reset. Remember what happened on Haumea...

spans.text: That much is true, but the situation now is more dangerous than ever before. One mistake, and you won't even have the chance to be reset. Remember what happened on Haumea...

units.rawText: Ahhhhhhhh I can't take it anymore! Xuannu, shut him up already! I'm beginning to suspect he's doing all this to get back at me for not playing his favorite song just now!
units.displayText: Ahhhhhhhh I can't take it anymore! Xuannu, shut him up already! I'm beginning to suspect he's doing all this to get back at me for not playing his favorite song just now!

spans.text: Ahhhhhhhh I can't take it anymore! Xuannu, shut him up already! I'm beginning to suspect he's doing all this to get back at me for not playing his favorite song just now!

units.rawText: Hehe. Seeing the two of you like this actually puts me at ease.
units.displayText: Hehe. Seeing the two of you like this actually puts me at ease.

spans.text: Hehe. Seeing the two of you like this actually puts me at ease.

units.rawText: The agent within the image smiles as she watches the two veteran buddies bantering with each other.
units.displayText: The agent within the image smiles as she watches the two veteran buddies bantering with each other.

spans.text: The agent within the image smiles as she watches the two veteran buddies bantering with each other.

units.rawText: Xinghuan, you were working on overhauling your space exo-armor just now, right? What's your progress like?
units.displayText: Xinghuan, you were working on overhauling your space exo-armor just now, right? What's your progress like?

spans.text: Xinghuan, you were working on overhauling your space exo-armor just now, right? What's your progress like?

units.rawText: Ahaha, I can't keep anything from you after all. I asked the engineers to help boost the output of the Hellbore Cannon. Once the battle starts, you'll be able to see me firing at maximum power!
units.displayText: Ahaha, I can't keep anything from you after all. I asked the engineers to help boost the output of the Hellbore Cannon. Once the battle starts, you'll be able to see me firing at maximum power!

spans.text: Ahaha, I can't keep anything from you after all. I asked the engineers to help boost the output of the Hellbore Cannon. Once the battle starts, you'll be able to see me firing at maximum power!

units.rawText: Mm. Before this you were only garrisoned at the Titan Observatory. This time, you'll be in your element. Looking forward to your performance.
units.displayText: Mm. Before this you were only garrisoned at the Titan Observatory. This time, you'll be in your element. Looking forward to your performance.

spans.text: Mm. Before this you were only garrisoned at the Titan Observatory. This time, you'll be in your element. Looking forward to your performance.

units.rawText: Relax, I'm the ace taikonaut of the Jiutian Plan. I'll make sure I bring back all the data in the base!
units.displayText: Relax, I'm the ace taikonaut of the Jiutian Plan. I'll make sure I bring back all the data in the base!

spans.text: Relax, I'm the ace taikonaut of the Jiutian Plan. I'll make sure I bring back all the data in the base!

units.rawText: There are still a lot of uncertain elements at the Titan base. For safety's sake, the Millennium Pegasus will not be landing directly on Titan.
units.displayText: There are still a lot of uncertain elements at the Titan base. For safety's sake, the Millennium Pegasus will not be landing directly on Titan.

spans.text: There are still a lot of uncertain elements at the Titan base. For safety's sake, the Millennium Pegasus will not be landing directly on Titan.

units.rawText: The entropic encroachment is spreading very rapidly. Recover all the data before it reaches the observatory and the Pegasus will pick you up in orbit.
units.displayText: The entropic encroachment is spreading very rapidly. Recover all the data before it reaches the observatory and the Pegasus will pick you up in orbit.

spans.text: The entropic encroachment is spreading very rapidly. Recover all the data before it reaches the observatory and the Pegasus will pick you up in orbit.

units.rawText: According to our calculations, recovering all the data should take about 4 hours, right?
units.displayText: According to our calculations, recovering all the data should take about 4 hours, right?

spans.text: According to our calculations, recovering all the data should take about 4 hours, right?

units.rawText: Correct. You need to hurry and get it done before Pan's Stellar Engine fully ignites.
units.displayText: Correct. You need to hurry and get it done before Pan's Stellar Engine fully ignites.

spans.text: Correct. You need to hurry and get it done before Pan's Stellar Engine fully ignites.

units.rawText: I reviewed the footage of the entropic encroachment of Haumea. There's no way to keep all the data safe without a fight.
units.displayText: I reviewed the footage of the entropic encroachment of Haumea. There's no way to keep all the data safe without a fight.

spans.text: I reviewed the footage of the entropic encroachment of Haumea. There's no way to keep all the data safe without a fight.

units.rawText: After modification, your exo is now far quicker than the entropics. You could bypass them with sheer speed.
units.displayText: After modification, your exo is now far quicker than the entropics. You could bypass them with sheer speed.

spans.text: After modification, your exo is now far quicker than the entropics. You could bypass them with sheer speed.

units.rawText: The entropic hordes have already landed on Titan, and we're picking up large amounts of them in the southern polar region.
units.displayText: The entropic hordes have already landed on Titan, and we're picking up large amounts of them in the southern polar region.

spans.text: The entropic hordes have already landed on Titan, and we're picking up large amounts of them in the southern polar region.

units.rawText: The North Pole region seems free of entropics for now... And there are some small sand dunes that could be used as cover.
units.displayText: The North Pole region seems free of entropics for now... And there are some small sand dunes that could be used as cover.

spans.text: The North Pole region seems free of entropics for now... And there are some small sand dunes that could be used as cover.

units.rawText: In that case...
units.displayText: In that case...

spans.text: In that case...

units.rawText: <size=40>We'll break through from the north!</size>
units.displayText: We'll break through from the north!

spans.text: We'll break through from the north!

units.rawText: You're practically finishing each others' sentences. Then again, I expected nothing less from a pair of veterans who've completed several hundred space missions together.
units.displayText: You're practically finishing each others' sentences. Then again, I expected nothing less from a pair of veterans who've completed several hundred space missions together.

spans.text: You're practically finishing each others' sentences. Then again, I expected nothing less from a pair of veterans who've completed several hundred space missions together.

units.rawText: Still, bear in mind that the gaseous makeup and atmospheric pressure of Titan is nothing like that of Earth.
units.displayText: Still, bear in mind that the gaseous makeup and atmospheric pressure of Titan is nothing like that of Earth.

spans.text: Still, bear in mind that the gaseous makeup and atmospheric pressure of Titan is nothing like that of Earth.

units.rawText: Watch out for the methane ice caps, yeah? Relax, I trained for space operations on Titan. I know the place like the back of my hand.
units.displayText: Watch out for the methane ice caps, yeah? Relax, I trained for space operations on Titan. I know the place like the back of my hand.

spans.text: Watch out for the methane ice caps, yeah? Relax, I trained for space operations on Titan. I know the place like the back of my hand.

units.rawText: Xinghuan picks up her helmet and smiles.
units.displayText: Xinghuan picks up her helmet and smiles.

spans.text: Xinghuan picks up her helmet and smiles.

units.rawText: The data on Titan is of vital importance to the future of mankind and Earth as a whole. I know that better than anything, so relax and leave it to me.
units.displayText: The data on Titan is of vital importance to the future of mankind and Earth as a whole. I know that better than anything, so relax and leave it to me.

spans.text: The data on Titan is of vital importance to the future of mankind and Earth as a whole. I know that better than anything, so relax and leave it to me.

units.rawText: Compared to that, you'll have to manage data recovery for the entire Saturnian system, so feel free to pay attention to the other Saturnian satellites while you're monitoring the big picture.
units.displayText: Compared to that, you'll have to manage data recovery for the entire Saturnian system, so feel free to pay attention to the other Saturnian satellites while you're monitoring the big picture.

spans.text: Compared to that, you'll have to manage data recovery for the entire Saturnian system, so feel free to pay attention to the other Saturnian satellites while you're monitoring the big picture.

units.rawText: As a pilot, I'll make sure I complete my mission. As for you, your mission is keeping an eye on everything and making sure we all make it back safely, right?
units.displayText: As a pilot, I'll make sure I complete my mission. As for you, your mission is keeping an eye on everything and making sure we all make it back safely, right?

spans.text: As a pilot, I'll make sure I complete my mission. As for you, your mission is keeping an eye on everything and making sure we all make it back safely, right?

units.rawText: Heh, yeah... It's about time.
units.displayText: Heh, yeah... It's about time.

spans.text: Heh, yeah... It's about time.

units.rawText: Yuwang smiles and nods. Xinghuan raises her hand, and Yuwang bumps his fist against hers.
units.displayText: Yuwang smiles and nods. Xinghuan raises her hand, and Yuwang bumps his fist against hers.

spans.text: Yuwang smiles and nods. Xinghuan raises her hand, and Yuwang bumps his fist against hers.

units.rawText: Double check your exo's comm gear. You'll be heading out in 10 minutes.
units.displayText: Double check your exo's comm gear. You'll be heading out in 10 minutes.

spans.text: Double check your exo's comm gear. You'll be heading out in 10 minutes.

units.rawText: I've been waiting forever for you to say that.
units.displayText: I've been waiting forever for you to say that.

spans.text: I've been waiting forever for you to say that.

units.rawText: Xinghuan rubs her hands with glee, then springs off the wall to launch herself toward her exo while scooping up the half-full box of nutrient bars in passing. She grabs the handrail of her exo as she nears it and neatly slots herself into the gigantic steel god of war in one swift motion.
units.displayText: Xinghuan rubs her hands with glee, then springs off the wall to launch herself toward her exo while scooping up the half-full box of nutrient bars in passing. She grabs the handrail of her exo as she nears it and neatly slots herself into the gigantic steel god of war in one swift motion.

units.rawText: Deet—the moment she straps herself in, Yuwang's face appears on the communications window in front of her.
units.displayText: Deet—the moment she straps herself in, Yuwang's face appears on the communications window in front of her.

spans.text: Deet—the moment she straps herself in, Yuwang's face appears on the communications window in front of her.

units.rawText: How does it feel?
units.displayText: How does it feel?

spans.text: How does it feel?

units.rawText: Pretty good. Comms are fine. At the very least I'm not seeing any distortion in my field of view. Your hair looks kind of green, though.
units.displayText: Pretty good. Comms are fine. At the very least I'm not seeing any distortion in my field of view. Your hair looks kind of green, though.

spans.text: Pretty good. Comms are fine. At the very least I'm not seeing any distortion in my field of view. Your hair looks kind of green, though.

units.rawText: ...That's my normal hair color.
units.displayText: ...That's my normal hair color.

spans.text: ...That's my normal hair color.

units.rawText: Right, also, there's this!
units.displayText: Right, also, there's this!

spans.text: Right, also, there's this!

units.rawText: Xinghuan waves the nutrient bar she's holding.
units.displayText: Xinghuan waves the nutrient bar she's holding.

spans.text: Xinghuan waves the nutrient bar she's holding.

units.rawText: Is that mine?
units.displayText: Is that mine?

spans.text: Is that mine?

units.rawText: Hey, I've got to keep my energy levels up during the mission, right? So I swiped it. I'll pay you back later.
units.displayText: Hey, I've got to keep my energy levels up during the mission, right? So I swiped it. I'll pay you back later.

spans.text: Hey, I've got to keep my energy levels up during the mission, right? So I swiped it. I'll pay you back later.

units.rawText: Now, let's try one of... eh... Is this bitter coffee flavored?!
units.displayText: Now, let's try one of... eh... Is this bitter coffee flavored?!

spans.text: Now, let's try one of... eh... Is this bitter coffee flavored?!

units.rawText: I swapped to that flavor because I knew you'd swipe it.
units.displayText: I swapped to that flavor because I knew you'd swipe it.

spans.text: I swapped to that flavor because I knew you'd swipe it.

units.rawText: Uehhh... This is way too bitter... is this how you treat yourself?
units.displayText: Uehhh... This is way too bitter... is this how you treat yourself?

spans.text: Uehhh... This is way too bitter... is this how you treat yourself?

units.rawText: All food needs to do is to provide energy and functionality.
units.displayText: All food needs to do is to provide energy and functionality.

spans.text: All food needs to do is to provide energy and functionality.

units.rawText: But you should be nicer to your taste buds. I'll buy you lunch when I get back!
units.displayText: But you should be nicer to your taste buds. I'll buy you lunch when I get back!

spans.text: But you should be nicer to your taste buds. I'll buy you lunch when I get back!

units.rawText: We'll talk about that when you do. In any case, it's time...
units.displayText: We'll talk about that when you do. In any case, it's time...

spans.text: We'll talk about that when you do. In any case, it's time...

units.rawText: Return in triumph. Glory to Jiutian.
units.displayText: Return in triumph. Glory to Jiutian.

spans.text: Return in triumph. Glory to Jiutian.

units.rawText: Xinghuan looks at her partner's image on her screen and smiles proudly.
units.displayText: Xinghuan looks at her partner's image on her screen and smiles proudly.

spans.text: Xinghuan looks at her partner's image on her screen and smiles proudly.

units.rawText: Yes, yes, yes, return in triumph, glory to Jiutian.
units.displayText: Yes, yes, yes, return in triumph, glory to Jiutian.

spans.text: Yes, yes, yes, return in triumph, glory to Jiutian.

units.rawText: The reactor begins its startup sequence and the engine emits a low roar. Inside the cockpit, instrument dials and various readouts spring to life as they receive power.
units.displayText: The reactor begins its startup sequence and the engine emits a low roar. Inside the cockpit, instrument dials and various readouts spring to life as they receive power.

spans.text: The reactor begins its startup sequence and the engine emits a low roar. Inside the cockpit, instrument dials and various readouts spring to life as they receive power.

units.rawText: Space exo-armor has arrived at the launch deck. Linear catapult voltage raised from 220V to 550V.
units.displayText: Space exo-armor has arrived at the launch deck. Linear catapult voltage raised from 220V to 550V.

spans.text: Space exo-armor has arrived at the launch deck. Linear catapult voltage raised from 220V to 550V.

units.displayText: Securing cables disconnected. Launch preparations complete. Launch sequence transferred to pilot control.

spans.text: Securing cables disconnected. Launch preparations complete. Launch sequence transferred to pilot control.

units.rawText: Whew— Right, preflight checklist complete, all readings nominal...
units.displayText: Whew— Right, preflight checklist complete, all readings nominal...

spans.text: Whew— Right, preflight checklist complete, all readings nominal...

units.rawText: Beepbeep, beepbeep.
units.displayText: Beepbeep, beepbeep.

spans.text: Beepbeep, beepbeep.

units.rawText: A mini-robot suddenly appears near the exo-armor. Its round body is a little unbalanced, but it does its best to reach out and pat Xinghuan's shoulder.
units.displayText: A mini-robot suddenly appears near the exo-armor. Its round body is a little unbalanced, but it does its best to reach out and pat Xinghuan's shoulder.

spans.text: A mini-robot suddenly appears near the exo-armor. Its round body is a little unbalanced, but it does its best to reach out and pat Xinghuan's shoulder.

units.rawText: Hey, Liuxing! You move fast.
units.displayText: Hey, Liuxing! You move fast.

spans.text: Hey, Liuxing! You move fast.

units.rawText: Beepbeep, beepbeepbeep.
units.displayText: Beepbeep, beepbeepbeep.

spans.text: Beepbeep, beepbeepbeep.

units.rawText: Haha, in that case, I'll let you handle targeting assistance. We're heading out right now.
units.displayText: Haha, in that case, I'll let you handle targeting assistance. We're heading out right now.

spans.text: Haha, in that case, I'll let you handle targeting assistance. We're heading out right now.

units.rawText: <size=100><color=orange>Taikonaut Xinghuan, launching!</color></size>
units.displayText: Taikonaut Xinghuan, launching!

spans.text: Taikonaut Xinghuan, launching!

units.rawText: The exo hurtles off the deck, a bright, shining star in the darkness of deep space.
units.displayText: The exo hurtles off the deck, a bright, shining star in the darkness of deep space.

spans.text: The exo hurtles off the deck, a bright, shining star in the darkness of deep space.

units.rawText: At the outskirts of Titan's atmosphere.
units.displayText: At the outskirts of Titan's atmosphere.

spans.text: At the outskirts of Titan's atmosphere.

units.displayText: Warning! High-energy reaction detected at target location. Suspected entropic horde present.

spans.text: Warning! High-energy reaction detected at target location. Suspected entropic horde present.

units.rawText: As Xinghuan approaches Titan, the ravaged planet fills her line of sight. The planet's surface is crisscrossed with many dark purple scars.
units.displayText: As Xinghuan approaches Titan, the ravaged planet fills her line of sight. The planet's surface is crisscrossed with many dark purple scars.

spans.text: As Xinghuan approaches Titan, the ravaged planet fills her line of sight. The planet's surface is crisscrossed with many dark purple scars.

units.rawText: Looks like things are worse than I expected. It seems the nearby asteroids have been affected, too.
units.displayText: Looks like things are worse than I expected. It seems the nearby asteroids have been affected, too.

spans.text: Looks like things are worse than I expected. It seems the nearby asteroids have been affected, too.

units.rawText: To say that breaking through their blockade head-on will be hard is an understatement.
units.displayText: To say that breaking through their blockade head-on will be hard is an understatement.

spans.text: To say that breaking through their blockade head-on will be hard is an understatement.

units.rawText: Beepbeep, beepbeepbeepbeep.
units.displayText: Beepbeep, beepbeepbeepbeep.

units.rawText: Data retrieval in the Saturnian system is 63% complete. Things should start looking up once we upload the Titan base's data.
units.displayText: Data retrieval in the Saturnian system is 63% complete. Things should start looking up once we upload the Titan base's data.

spans.text: Data retrieval in the Saturnian system is 63% complete. Things should start looking up once we upload the Titan base's data.

units.rawText: We don't have much time left.
units.displayText: We don't have much time left.

spans.text: We don't have much time left.

units.rawText: Xuannu's eyes do not leave the big screen in front of her. Said screen is simulating a comet's projected path.
units.displayText: Xuannu's eyes do not leave the big screen in front of her. Said screen is simulating a comet's projected path.

spans.text: Xuannu's eyes do not leave the big screen in front of her. Said screen is simulating a comet's projected path.

units.rawText: Upon enlargement of satellite imagery of the comet, the densely-packed scars of entropization send a chill down her spine.
units.displayText: Upon enlargement of satellite imagery of the comet, the densely-packed scars of entropization send a chill down her spine.

spans.text: Upon enlargement of satellite imagery of the comet, the densely-packed scars of entropization send a chill down her spine.

units.rawText: The latest calculations are in. According to the data collected from the comet when it was in the Uranian system... the comet will enter Saturn's orbit in 5 hours' time.
units.displayText: The latest calculations are in. According to the data collected from the comet when it was in the Uranian system... the comet will enter Saturn's orbit in 5 hours' time.

spans.text: The latest calculations are in. According to the data collected from the comet when it was in the Uranian system... the comet will enter Saturn's orbit in 5 hours' time.

units.rawText: I reached the same result as you.
units.displayText: I reached the same result as you.

spans.text: I reached the same result as you.

units.rawText: What about the heavy exo-armor corps from the Ringworld garrison?
units.displayText: What about the heavy exo-armor corps from the Ringworld garrison?

spans.text: What about the heavy exo-armor corps from the Ringworld garrison?

units.rawText: They're currently preparing themselves. They aren't all gathered yet, but that entropic comet isn't going to wait for us.
units.displayText: They're currently preparing themselves. They aren't all gathered yet, but that entropic comet isn't going to wait for us.

spans.text: They're currently preparing themselves. They aren't all gathered yet, but that entropic comet isn't going to wait for us.

units.rawText: It's time to proceed with the interception plan. Yuwang, is Pan ready?
units.displayText: It's time to proceed with the interception plan. Yuwang, is Pan ready?

spans.text: It's time to proceed with the interception plan. Yuwang, is Pan ready?

units.rawText: The Stellar Engine tests are complete. Just give us the order, and we'll commence primary ignition.
units.displayText: The Stellar Engine tests are complete. Just give us the order, and we'll commence primary ignition.

spans.text: The Stellar Engine tests are complete. Just give us the order, and we'll commence primary ignition.

units.rawText: Although... once we start, we won't be able to change Pan's direction again.
units.displayText: Although... once we start, we won't be able to change Pan's direction again.

spans.text: Although... once we start, we won't be able to change Pan's direction again.

units.rawText: ...I just checked. I'm picking up a high-energy operand reaction from the main entropic comet.
units.displayText: ...I just checked. I'm picking up a high-energy operand reaction from the main entropic comet.

spans.text: ...I just checked. I'm picking up a high-energy operand reaction from the main entropic comet.

units.rawText: The entropics' leader is coming.
units.displayText: The entropics' leader is coming.

spans.text: The entropics' leader is coming.

units.rawText: If she reaches Jovian orbit, the Jovian Ringworld and the Admin Center will be completely exposed to them.
units.displayText: If she reaches Jovian orbit, the Jovian Ringworld and the Admin Center will be completely exposed to them.

spans.text: If she reaches Jovian orbit, the Jovian Ringworld and the Admin Center will be completely exposed to them.

units.rawText: The Ringworld is our home and the core of Jiutian. We must stop her in the Saturnian system. We cannot allow her to threaten the Ringworld.
units.displayText: The Ringworld is our home and the core of Jiutian. We must stop her in the Saturnian system. We cannot allow her to threaten the Ringworld.

spans.text: The Ringworld is our home and the core of Jiutian. We must stop her in the Saturnian system. We cannot allow her to threaten the Ringworld.

units.rawText: Understood. In half an hour's time, I will activate Pan's Stellar Engine and move Pan onto the desired course.
units.displayText: Understood. In half an hour's time, I will activate Pan's Stellar Engine and move Pan onto the desired course.

spans.text: Understood. In half an hour's time, I will activate Pan's Stellar Engine and move Pan onto the desired course.

units.rawText: If it is successful, we can intercept the comet that way.
units.displayText: If it is successful, we can intercept the comet that way.

spans.text: If it is successful, we can intercept the comet that way.

units.rawText: Pan does not have much mass. Even if impact does not completely destroy the comet, it should slow the entropics down.
units.displayText: Pan does not have much mass. Even if impact does not completely destroy the comet, it should slow the entropics down.

spans.text: Pan does not have much mass. Even if impact does not completely destroy the comet, it should slow the entropics down.

units.rawText: Attention all combat personnel, accelerate combat preparations.
units.displayText: Attention all combat personnel, accelerate combat preparations.

spans.text: Attention all combat personnel, accelerate combat preparations.

units.rawText: <size=40>By the light of the stars, victory shall be Jiutian's!</size>
units.displayText: By the light of the stars, victory shall be Jiutian's!

spans.text: By the light of the stars, victory shall be Jiutian's!

units.rawText: It's been a while, Xinghuan. What are you doing?
units.displayText: It's been a while, Xinghuan. What are you doing?

spans.text: It's been a while, Xinghuan. What are you doing?
